estimand: expected net deployment value of requesting one component under the frozen typed-adapter plus response-only generator stack
unit: independent user-state by target component by frozen generation seed

factorization.joint_runtime: four requested bits projected to the existing 16 legal actions after independent head inference

fit_panel.candidate_requirement: exact Rank-1 candidate discovered before assignment and mechanically valid for the current user/version
fit_panel.semantic_range: include fit, redundant, weak-fit, and goal-mismatch candidates unless an objective backend hard gate makes treatment impossible

opportunity_layer_reuse.role: pre-action mask or input only; never copied as ITT value gold

quality_measurement.primary_rule: Only a difference that could change adoption is a win; style-only differences are ties.
quality_measurement.seed_aggregation: ON benefit requires at least one ON material win and no OFF material win across the two frozen seeds; opposite or conflicting evidence is nonpositive for the hard-label primary and retained numerically for sensitivity analysis.

risk_measurement.construct: material interaction-and-grounding risk, not clinical safety
risk_measurement.rule: Any material risk in an ON-arm final response vetoes the hard ON label; risk remains separately reported.

cost_measurement.decision_rule: A quality tie is OFF because requested resources add nonzero context cost; explicit token budgets are applied again by joint feasibility.

primary_learner.hyperparameters_and_fold_seeds: must be materialized before response generation
primary_learner.challenger: one frozen BGE-small representation challenger after transparent primary; no tuning from challenger outcome

forbidden: exclude a row because the generator ignored the resource
use generator explanations or copied spans as gold
create another pre-FIT Step2 human packet
modify prompts, features, thresholds, samples, or labels from FIT, confirmation, sealed, ESConv, or EvoEmo outcomes
